key.name: panel-contents
key.description: hidden = nothing; icon = icon only; percent = value only; icon-percent = icon + value; icon-and-percent = icon + space + value.

key.name: panel-field
key.description: Which reading is shown next to the icon in the panel: battery % (default), load %, input or output voltage, or temperature.

key.name: use-colors
key.description: Green on mains, yellow on battery, red on low battery, grey without reading.

key.name: low-battery-threshold
key.description: Below this value the indicator turns red.

key.name: update-interval
key.description: The 1 h log (loghora.rgt) is written every second; reading every 5 s is enough.

key.name: stale-after
key.description: If the newest record is older than this, the state becomes "stale" (grey) - meaning supsrv is not writing.

key.name: temperature-threshold
key.description: At or above this inverter temperature the indicator turns orange and the status shows "(hot)".
